questions.stem: A circle is cut at the endpoints of a diameter, and one of the two arcs between those endpoints is traced. What is the degree measure of that semicircular arc? "270 degrees." is the answer a classmate submitted. Diagnose the mistake in that choice, then select the option that is fully correct.

options.misconception: uses a full turn where a half turn is required

questions.explanation: A full turn around a circle measures 360 degrees. A diameter splits the circumference into two equal arcs, so each semicircular arc measures 360/2 = 180 degrees. A 90-degree arc is only a quarter circle, 270 degrees is three quarters, and 360 degrees is the whole circle; none of those is half. The endpoint pair therefore subtends a 180-degree arc on either side.
